rationale: The candidate remains the strongest final-round choice: its hindcast SMAPE of 5.50 is substantially lower than 10.25, 11.67, and 12.96, and no supplied fold evidence establishes instability or its failure condition. The forecast-window evidence in doc_7407 supports its recent-level-persistence component by documenting a tight, horizontal, non-periodic post-update equilibrium, while directly contradicting the harmonic and phase-recurrence assumptions of the competing candidates. Doc_7396 confirms that the temporary indexing shock ended before the horizon and utilization returned to baseline. Doc_7406 is only undated directional counterevidence and lacks verified horizon overlap or magnitude, so it cannot support overriding the stable historical leader with the much weaker regime_damped_harmonic candidate. The observation-session boundary and logging-start evidence do not establish a latent CPU transition or measurement distortion requiring adjustment.
